title: Trump expected to pick conservative policy wonk Heidi Overton to lead FDA
summary: Prior to Overton’s current White House role, she worked on health policy for the America First Policy Institute, a conservative think tank previously helmed by Brooke Rollins, who now serves as Trump’s agriculture secretary.
